results: Implemented internal/auth/oidc.go with OIDCValidator, StateManager, NonceTracker, KeySet, and IDTokenClaims parsing supporting RS256, EdDSA, and HS256.
Requirement F07 acceptance verified: wrong issuer, wrong audience, nonce replay, invalid callback state, state expiration, and expired token rejections strictly enforced.

Required negative security cases verified: missing/unauthenticated subject, replayed state/nonce, forged alg:none headers, unstripped gateway headers, cross-scope access without admin privileges, and identity provider outages fail closed.
Private resources fail closed with PRIVATE_RESOURCE_FAIL_CLOSED on unauthenticated or invalid token callbacks.
Normalized identity output emits strongly typed storage.CallerIdentity and policy.SubjectIdentity with UntrustedHeadersStripped: true and Authenticated: true for valid callbacks.
Added --validate-oidc CLI flag in cmd/policyhelix/main.go to execute complete OIDC callback and token validation from JSON fixtures.
tests/oidc_test.go covers the entire fixture manifest, F07 acceptance criteria, all negative cases, multi-algorithm verification (RS256, Ed25519, HS256), and CLI execution.
Thirteen Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures generated and hash-verified under tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C13/manifest.json.
observed_limitations: All cryptographic validation uses Go standard library crypto packages; no external third-party OIDC/JWT dependencies were introduced.
Keys are configured via in-memory KeySet or per-invocation trusted_keys in the fixture envelope; dynamic remote JWKS discovery over network is disabled to preserve ADR-0003 local-first constraints.
Session persistence and cookie rotation are reserved for C14 (feat(sessions): persist revocable server side sessions); C13 validates the initial token exchange and emits normalized identity.
